name: hide-protocol-app-vpn
description: Hide Protocol VPN - Scripts de automação Flutter para Android e iOS (Diego)

scripts.start:android: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7 -no-snapshot-load -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7.log 2>&1 &)) && adb wait-for-device && until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done && flutter run -d emulator-5554
scripts.start:ios: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$PATH" && open -a Simulator && sleep 3 && flutter run -d ios
scripts.emulator:android: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-' && echo 'Emulador já está aberto!' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7 -no-snapshot-load -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7.log 2>&1 & echo 'Iniciando emulador Pixel_7 (modo GPU estável)...'))
scripts.emulator:open: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7 -no-snapshot-load -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7.log 2>&1 &))
scripts.emulator:open:playstore: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$HOME/Android/Sdk/platform-tools:$HOME/Android/Sdk/emulator:$PATH" && (adb devices | grep -q 'emulator-' || (rm -f ~/.android/avd/*.avd/*.lock && nohup emulator -avd Pixel_7_PlayStore -no-snapshot-load -gpu swiftshader_indirect -no-audio >/tmp/emulator_pixel7_playstore.log 2>&1 &))
scripts.clean: export PATH="$HOME/develop/flutter/bin:$PATH" && flutter clean && flutter pub get

author: Diego
